requirement.statement: The system SHALL implement AI Data Workflow as an EagerDataFlow-backed RunGraph layer.

case.when: An AI Data Workflow run graph is created
case.then: The graph SHALL preserve nodes, input/output config and dependency edges from the EagerDataFlow plan

case.given: A completed node is modified by a graph patch
case.then: The system SHALL create a new generation and invalidate downstream nodes without deleting prior records

case.given: A new generation has an invalidated node with an unchanged semantic fingerprint
case.when: The node reuse policy is semantic-hash
case.then: The system SHALL allow run-local reuse of the previous result
